pattern.rule: In a 'which new set of trials would best test whether X matters under condition Y' design item, the key is the only option that both varies the stem's factor and sets the stem's condition.
pattern.why: Both graders named the same rule on the same three items (3 of 3 vs 25%). Each is already dropped by R6 (both graders, 2+ distractors), so R8 removes nothing further. Brief rule 1 regressed when SI items were raised; v12e/v12f authors told before their packets.
